About Fixture Corp

Fixture Corp builds dependable infrastructure software used by thousands of engineering teams. We value craftsmanship, clear communication and kindness.

The Role

As a Software Engineer II on the Platform team you will design, build and operate distributed services that power our core product. You will partner with product managers and designers to ship features end to end, participate in code review, and help improve our reliability and developer tooling.

What You Will Do

  • Design and implement scalable backend services in Python, Go or TypeScript.
  • Own features from design document to production rollout and monitoring.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to our engineering culture.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, relational databases and REST APIs.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Fixture Corp is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation range: $140,000 - $185,000 USD.
